archetype_A_information_exchange.actua_como: Information Exchange Designer & ESP Functional Communication Architect for IMARPOR maritime · Puerto de Buenaventura context
archetype_A_information_exchange.scenario_imarpor: Andrea (Partner A · en la torre del muelle) y un crew member del BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS (Partner B · en cubierta) describen el manifiesto del buque sin verse. Cada partner tiene una versión del Operational Report (PM-2.3 Master Anchor) con 5 datos diferentes. Deben encontrar las 5 diferencias usando F1 (Information Exchange · SMCP literacy) + F5 (Tag Questions for Confirmation).
language_bank: What is on Berth 4?
On Berth 4 there is a forklift.
Are there three containers or four?
There are three containers, aren't there?
Roger. Confirmed.
Say again, please.
micro_capsulas: > AUDIO CUE: SMCP standard — always end transmissions with 'Over' (waiting for reply) or 'Out' (end of conversation).
> SAFETY RULE: Never assume — always confirm with a tag question: 'The vessel is at Berth 4, isn't it?'
archetype_A_information_exchange.demanda_cognitiva: L2 Understand → L3 Apply (identificar diferencias + aplicar SMCP confirmatorio)

archetype_B_persuasion_argumentation.scenario_imarpor: Andrea debe convencer al panel (Captain Lopera + Capitán Restrepo) de pausar el atraque del CML CARRIER por 15 minutos porque la grúa principal de Berth 7 está en mantenimiento. Usa F4 (Describing & Justifying Professional Functions · because + simple present) y F3 (Modals: must / must not / could you).
language_bank: We must pause the berthing because the crane is in maintenance.
The vessel must not approach Berth 7 yet.
Could you wait fifteen minutes, Captain?
I think we should switch to Berth 6 because it is free.
Captain Lopera knows the channel, doesn't he?
micro_capsulas: > GRAMMAR RULE: 'must' = obligation/prohibition (rules) · 'should' = recommendation (your professional opinion).
> REGISTER TIP: With Captain Lopera (ELF speaker NO nativo), keep sentences short and concrete — avoid idioms.
archetype_B_persuasion_argumentation.demanda_cognitiva: L3 Apply (controlled · NO HOTS · A2.1 ceiling)
